scope: Theorem 10.2 (Moving two-terminal crossing formula) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 170. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Tn be tiled disks of the class in Theorem 6.7, with mesh tending to zero, thick normalizations, and a common bounded physical range. In one color wire separately all the slots of two disjoint boundary intervals An, Bn, and impose no other ties. Suppose the four interval endpoints converge in chart coordinates to four distinct points in their prescribed cyclic order. If χ is their ordered cross-ratio, then PTn (An ↔ Bn) −→ g(χ). The statement holds for either color, including cut-triangle cells and repeated physical boundary locations with distinct incidences. Equivalently, the error is uniform over sequences with fixed thickness and fixed positive chart separation of the four endpoints.
